capabilities: Track focused work sessions with a timeblock timer
Capture post-session effort receipts and daily check-ins
Monitor effort, flow, recovery, and burnout-risk patterns over time
Forecast effort for multi-day projects from past history
Write a daily summary file for use in Templater daily notes
extras: No local-only mode: session data syncs to api.effortmastery.com (the README says note contents are never uploaded). Freemium: some insights are PRO-only. Ships an optional companion theme.
intentEvidence: Instead of forcing you into a brand-new productivity system, it adds an effort-aware layer to Obsidian
motivation: The author built it because "A task list can say you're doing fine while your actual capacity says otherwise" and wanted an effort-aware layer on top of existing workflows.
problem: Task lists and time trackers show what got done but not what the work cost in energy, flow, and burnout risk.

relations.evidence: If you use Templater and Periodic Notes, you can pull this data into your daily notes automatically.
If you use Templater and Periodic Notes, you can pull this data into your daily notes automatically.

requires.name: PRO plan for extra insights (Discovery, expanded Warnings)

summary: Effort tracker that logs work sessions, daily energy check-ins, and burnout signals, syncing data with the Effort Mastery web service.
